WELCOME TO BARDMOOR BLITZ!

Pull the red lever or press SPIN. Match three pictures, or use Napkin Cat and Hurricane Alicia as wild symbols to complete a triple. Bonus guest photos are now on the reels!

THREE MATCHING PICTURES: Win the amount shown in the payout table below. +100: Two Brooke portraits (without a bad-luck symbol). +500: Three mixed Brooke portraits. DUAL WILDS: Napkin Cat and Hurricane Alicia both substitute for matching pictures. One or two wilds plus matching pictures pay the picture's normal amount. Three Napkin Cats pay 5,000; three Hurricane Alicias pay 250; mixed three-wild combinations pay 5,000. BAD LUCK: Statue in other combinations. All points are fictional.
